# AgentOps Monitor (agentopsmonitor.com)
> Observability and cost tracking for AI agent runs. Pre-launch: this is a working ingest and trace-review tool, not a finished security product.

AgentOps Monitor accepts agent run and span telemetry over one authenticated HTTPS endpoint, records cost and token counts per run and per span, and renders the result as a run list and a run detail view.

## Core Capabilities
- **Run and span tracing**: Parent and child spans are recorded per run, with span type, status, timing, tokens, and cost shown on the run detail view. Up to 500 spans render per run, with an explicit notice when a run is truncated.
- **Cost & token capture**: Input and output token counts and cost, recorded per run and per span as reported by the client at ingest.
- **Framework support**: Framework adapters and an OpenTelemetry collector are planned. Today, any client that can POST JSON with a bearer token can send traces; see the quick start below.

## Quick Start (plain HTTPS ingestion)
Ingestion is a single authenticated HTTPS endpoint. Create an API key (prefix `aom_live_`) under Account -> API keys, then POST a JSON trace:
- Python: `requests.post("https://agentopsmonitor.com/api/ingest", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer aom_live_..."}, json={...})`
- Any other stack: send the same JSON body with the same `Authorization: Bearer aom_live_...` header.

Trace schema and error codes: see [Documentation & Integration Guides](https://agentopsmonitor.com/docs).
